label: Recovered Phule-Ambedkarite anti-caste feminist pedagogy as foundational Indian social theory
description: Rege led the Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule Women’s Studies Centre and centered Phule’s Satyashodhak tradition against upper-caste academic hegemony.
dialecticalTension: Reclaims anti-caste grassroots pedagogy as canonical sociological epistemology.
historicalContext: University of Pune / Dalit feminist scholarship (1991–2013).

label: Adapted Black feminist standpoint epistemology into Dalit Feminist Standpoint theory
description: Engaging Black feminist critiques of white feminism, Rege articulated how Dalit women’s marginality exposes interlocking caste, class, and patriarchal power.
dialecticalTension: Translates intersectional standpoint theory into the specific grammar of Indian caste.

label: Formulated Dalit Feminist Standpoint as an anti-caste, non-essentialist epistemic stance
description: Rege defined Dalit feminist standpoint not as a closed identity claim, but as an accountable epistemic commitment to reading society from the struggles of Dalit women.
dialecticalTension: Bridges lived testimonio with structural sociological critique.
